title: [29.x]-"El título Importe pendiente resulta ambiguo entre varios campos de la tabla Mov. proveedor." error if you try to Create Payment for some Vendor Ledger Entries filtered by Remaining Amount <> 0 in the Spanish version.
summary: Create Payment no longer fails with an ambiguous 'Importe pendiente' caption error when run for vendor ledger entries filtered by Remaining Amount <> 0 in the Spanish version. The Create Payment page was changed in both the ES and W1 layers.
key_points: Resolved ambiguous field title error when filtering by Remaining Amount
Applied fix to both Spanish and W1 versions of Create Payment page
Added test coverage for vendor payment filtering with Remaining Amount condition
